stage0009_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$レイアム$$
「All units report ready for launch.」

stage0009_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$キャシー$$
「It seems $$ウルズ$$ 7 hasn't rejoined yet...」

stage0009_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Master Sergeant $$マオ$$ asked, and I approved her leave.
　For her, this trip might be
　her last memory of school life.」

stage0009_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Smooth, boss and the major both.」

stage0009_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$マオ$$
「Thinking this month in $$第２新東京市$$
　is ending does make me a bit sad.」

stage0009_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$マオ$$
「Beer under the cherry blossoms was something else.」

stage0009_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Japanese girls are cute, too.
　Guess it's goodbye to them as well...」

stage0009_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$オズマ$$
「That's a story for after we
　beat down the guys headed our way.」

stage0009_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ボス$$
「We wanted to get leave too,
　and keep on with our school trip...」

stage0009_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't complain, $$ボス$$.
　Me and $$正太郎$$ got dragged out
　here to do this too, you know.」

stage0009_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$正太郎$$
「But is this okay?
　If $$甲児$$ and the others slip away
　mid-trip, won't it look suspicious?」

stage0009_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$甲児$$
「It's set that they all missed the bus together,
　and Miss $$スズネ$$ stays as their chaperone.」

stage0009_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$アルト$$
「After that, we clean up the terrorists
　and rejoin the class, no problem.」

stage0009_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「So having Miss $$スズネ$$ step in
　is how we cover it up.」

stage0009_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That's right.
　That's my most important job here.」

stage0009_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$スズネ$$
「And there's one more top priority...
　$n... I'm asking as your partner.
　Won't you tell me why you sortied alone?」

stage0009_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$n
「...Because if I keep relying on someone,
　I'll never become capable on my own.」

stage0009_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That's a rather sudden decision.
　Does that tie to what you told $$宗介$$ on the beach?」

stage0009_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Not even to a partner in life and death?」

stage0009_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$n
「...Sorry.
　But someday... I'll have you step down
　from the $$ジェニオン$$, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

stage0009_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$レイアム$$
「The enemy has split into three main groups...!」

stage0009_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$オットー$$
「Launch all our units as well!」

stage0009_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$リディ$$
「Mostly mercenaries from the
　《$$アストラギウス$$》 galaxy, huh...!」

stage0009_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$カツ$$
「Some people from that world apparently refused
　to be absorbed into the Earth Federation,
　and built their own society instead.」

stage0009_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$リディ$$
「Londo Bell can't afford to lose
　to a bunch of outlaw wannabes like that.」

stage0009_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$エマ$$
「But we can't let our guard down.
　With leadership crushed, they'll fight desperately.」

stage0009_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$オットー$$
「All units, intercept the terrorists!
　Let's bring this operation to a close!」

stage0009_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$甲児$$
「Wait for us, $$宗介$$.
　We'll wrap this up fast and catch up.」

stage0009_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$リディ$$
「Pretty passive of you.
　Did our strength spook you?」

stage0009_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Looks like the enemy means to lure us in and strike.」

stage0009_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$クラン$$
「Then we'll simply have to show them
　that tactic is useless...!」

stage0009_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$オットー$$
「To come at our rear like this...!」

stage0009_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Captain!
　Something else is coming!」

stage0009_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$アルト$$
「Dancouga Nova!
　So it's $$葵$$ and the others!」

stage0009_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$葵$$
「Long time no see, everyone.
　...Though this isn't the time for that.」

stage0009_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$くらら$$
「This is callsign Danger 1.
　Delivering a message from Captain Testarossa
　of $$ミスリル$$.」

stage0009_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$ミスリル$$...!?
　So Dancouga Nova's working with $$ミスリル$$ too...!」

stage0009_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$葵$$
「That's right.
　We've been acting on orders
　from the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$.」

stage0009_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$n
「The mystery robot that stepped into conflicts
　worldwide, always fighting for the losing side...」

stage0009_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$スズネ$$
「So they were fighting in $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ too.」

stage0009_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$くらら$$
「The forces deployed in this area right now
　are a decoy by the enemy...」

stage0009_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$くらら$$
「While our surveillance was locked onto this area,
　the jet carrying Jindai High students...
　$$千鳥かなめ$$ included, was hijacked.」

stage0009_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So we were set up, is that it.」

stage0009_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Skull Leader to all units!
　Let's wrap this up here as fast as we can!」

stage0009_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$葵$$!
　We're getting Team D to help too!」

stage0009_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$葵$$
「Of course...!
　That's exactly why we're here.」

stage0009_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Then let's team up with them
　and take down the terrorists.」

stage0009_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Handy, there's one moving alone, just right for us.」

stage0009_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「Pardon the intrusion, blue robot.」

stage0009_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$葵$$
「We're Team D,
　and this robot is $$ダンクーガノヴァマックスゴッド$$.」

stage0009_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$朔哉$$
「We were part of $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ too, with $$甲児$$ and the others.
　So, good to work with you.」

stage0009_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$n...!
　I won't allow personal matters right now!」

stage0009_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Right now, make it your priority
　to go save everyone as fast as you can!」

stage0009_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$葵$$
「Hmm... you keep such a cool face,
　but you've got quite a hot side, don't you.」

stage0009_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Fitting, for our tag partner.」

stage0009_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$葵$$
「All right, let's show $$アルト$$ and the others
　how hot we can get, for old times' sake.」

stage0009_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$朔哉$$
「I'll leave it to you today, $$葵$$!」

stage0009_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$モニカ$$
「Confirmed: the enemy force is wiped out.」

stage0009_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Hurry up and recover all units.
　We're chasing the hijacked plane right away.」

stage0009_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$甲児$$
「Wait for us, $$宗介$$, everyone...!
　We're coming right away!」

stage0009_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$n
「Let's go, Miss $$スズネ$$.
　To save everyone.」

stage0009_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$n
（I... I have to grow stronger...
　And when that day comes, I...）

stage0009_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$葵$$
「Now then... the message is delivered,
　but I don't plan on stopping at messenger.」

stage0009_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$くらら$$
「This time, I agree with $$葵$$.」

stage0009_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Guess in the end, this life over here
　just suits us better.」

stage0009_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Once you've tasted that kind of thrill,
　you just can't forget it.」

stage0009_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「And if $$ジョニー$$'s going to be there too,
　then a hiatus from idol work is unavoidable!」

stage0009_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$葵$$
「In short, we're all birds of a feather...
　so we don't need any extra words.」

stage0009_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$葵$$
「Get ready, terrorists!
　We're taking you down quick!」
